predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: French Gabon, a territory of French Equatorial Africa since 1910, fully independent on 17 August 1960; Cliopatria carries the land in its French Fifth Republic row for 1958-1960

ledger.x: 17 August 1960: Gabon becomes independent from France.

certainty.note: Judgment: the frontier is the French colonial line with Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea and the Republic of the Congo; the Gabon page is silent on boundary instruments and on the Mbanie dispute, so this is not a source.
